title: N Queens Problem Asymptotics
exact_target: Determine the asymptotic number of placements of n mutually nonattacking queens on an ordinary n-by-n board.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 149 (GREEN-061). CC BY 4.0.

Michael Simkin, \emph{The number of $n$-queens configurations}, arXiv:2107.13460v3 (2022), §1, Theorem 1.1. This theorem answers the recorded exponential-growth question: $Q(n)^{1/n}/n\to e^{-\alpha}$ for a variationally characterized constant $1.94<\alpha<1.9449$.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, maintained author list, Problem 97 and its comments, accessed 7 October 2026.
